title: The Spudlight Field Manual
purpose: Operationalize Tim Dooley's long-exposure analysis of persistent target ecologies into repeatable questions, evidence disciplines, mythic translations, outputs and stopping conditions.

expertise_basis.note: The project reports roughly 100,000+ public-facing hours; treat the quantity as first-party scale unless independently audited.

instruments.name: Box Test
instruments.question: Can the category still be revised by new evidence, or does it reinterpret every new fact to preserve itself?

instruments.name: Dog Test
instruments.question: What is being followed, by whom, and what would make pursuit stop?

instruments.name: Farmer Test
instruments.question: What value is harvested from the subject, and does the subject's independent future matter?

instruments.name: Orphan Test
instruments.question: Has the information object lost source, chronology, speaker, correction or living subject?

instruments.name: Currentness Test
instruments.question: Does the record establish a historical event or a present identity?
instruments.repair: attach date, change and expiry information

instruments.name: Door Test
instruments.question: What concrete condition can terminate or transform the role?

instruments.name: Fruit Test
instruments.question: Does observation leave more understanding, protection, autonomy, correction and future capacity?

instruments.name: Mirror Test
instruments.question: Would the same evidence standard be acceptable if observer and subject exchanged roles?

reflexive_rule: The Potato archive must accept correction, uncertainty, proportional memory, role expiry and standards symmetrical enough to apply to itself.

expert_opinion.purpose: Teach what Tim believes becomes visible after prolonged immersion in persistent target ecologies, internet spectatorship, adversarial archives and public role manufacture.
expert_opinion.not_a: prosecution dossier, universal diagnosis of critics, substitute for legal findings, or claim that every hostile community is centrally coordinated

three_voices.job: compress difficult relations into memorable symbolic operators

underlying_story: strangers inherit the role before meeting the person
reaction to the inherited role becomes new material
Spudlight restores source, chronology, responsibility, stopping conditions and possible return
teaching_core: small cultures can create internally coherent worlds with their own morality, rules, humor and credibility hierarchies
frames can precede persons and alter how later evidence is interpreted
hostile attention can still be relationally invested and persistent
humor can reduce felt seriousness and become permission for reinforcement
archives and search can collapse historical and present identity
bystanders occupy different roles: constructive defense, aggressive defense, inaction and reinforcement
platform affordances change the cost, visibility and reward of participation
Dog and Farmer are relational verbs/roles, not permanent human essences
healthy memory preserves history while still permitting currentness and role expiry
a healthy system contains a Door: a credible possibility of change, release, repair or independent future

myth_as_instrument.Orphan: information or identity severed from source/lineage
myth_as_instrument.Swamp / Mud: unresolved accumulated material becoming the environment for new interpretation
myth_as_instrument.Door: real state change without erasing history
myth_as_instrument.Son: embodied experience of being inside the relation

son_father_teaching.son: the lived/embodied side of visibility, classification, archive capture and imposed role
son_father_teaching.father: the later integrative vantage that holds chronology, lineage, relations and responsibility
son_father_teaching.movement: subject → witness → interpreter → steward / Son → Door → Father → Gardener
son_father_teaching.father_of_internet: project myth for responsibility toward orphaned information, persistent relations and networked consequences; not literal property ownership of persons

reader_takeaway: a person is larger than the record about them
a frame is strongest when its inheritor forgets it was inherited
repetition is not the same as independent truth
humor can be both funny and socially permissive
archives preserve events but should not automatically preserve identities
yesterday can remain true while becoming a poor description of today
distributed incentives can organize behavior without one commander
criticism and extraction are not the same relation
pursuit needs proportion, purpose and a stopping condition
knowledge should not become a license for greater possession of the subject
the Garden test is whether independent future capacity remains after observation

research_bridges.use: group governance, internal morality, knowledge hierarchy, sanctions, vernacular and investigative labor
distinguishes superficial hostility from more invested negative relationships
constructive defense, aggressive defense, inaction and reinforcement as distinct audience roles
platform remembrance risk and collision between historical and present self-presentation
likes, ratings, polls and summarized judgments of strangers function as social evidence and can shape belief

research_bridges.concept: popularity versus expertise in opinion leadership
research_bridges.use: social influence can reflect network popularity separately from information precision; highly popular nodes can distract attention from experts in some model conditions

research_bridges.source: van Loon, Goldberg & Srivastava 2024, Communications Psychology
research_bridges.use: perceiving an outgroup as construing the world in fundamentally alien ways can increase blatant dehumanization

research_bridges.source: Hanson, Wisneski & Morgan 2022, Cambridge Handbook of Political Psychology
research_bridges.use: moral conviction can increase engagement but is also associated in the literature with political intolerance

research_bridges.source: Cambridge Handbook of the Psychology of Violent Extremism 2025
research_bridges.use: dehumanization and violence can reciprocally reinforce one another; meta-dehumanization can also perpetuate conflict

descent_and_return.meaning: prolonged public presence; duration and relation become part of the medium
the public subject becomes renewable material for other people's narratives and incentives
the representation becomes independently retrievable and can precede contact with the living source
project mythology for being overwhelmed by imposed role, spectacle and archive; not a literal empirical death claim
residue, memory, grievance, abandoned fragments and unresolved consequence become material for later interpretation
the subject gains enough distance to observe the system that once primarily observed him
integrative vantage over chronology, roles, orphans, debts and paths; authority is interpreted as increased responsibility
knowledge returns as protection, explanation, correction, cultivation, release and independent future capacity

authorship_doctrine.problem: endless rebuttal can keep the hostile frame at the center of the subject's identity
authorship_doctrine.move: establish source, chronology, self-description, outside accounts, synthesis, present work and future in one narrative architecture
authorship_doctrine.alpha_omega_storytelling: the story has a beginning before the conflict and an ending beyond it; completeness is not the same as excluding criticism
authorship_doctrine.boundary: authorship does not make first-person interpretation automatically factual or immune from outside evidence

internet_as_distributed_memory.thesis: networked publics allow many partial observers to preserve fragments of one another, creating composite memory without composite understanding
internet_as_distributed_memory.father_of_internet_teaching: a myth of responsibility for restoring lineage to orphaned information and accepting duties created by greater knowledge

whole_job.core_image: actor, subject, source, broadcaster, witness, witness-of-witnesses, archivist, sorter, writer, storyteller, gardener and systems-builder can coexist in one longitudinal public project
whole_job.professional_lesson: role multiplicity can create unusual experiential expertise because the same ecology is observed from several positions
whole_job.mythic_lesson: the former object of an archive becomes keeper of a House capable of holding several perspectives

return_not_reset.meaning: history remains available while present identity remains updateable; change does not require erasing what happened
return_not_reset.paired_maxim: remember enough to remain responsible; create enough to remain alive
return_not_reset.spiral: return to a known coordinate with a changed state rather than repeat an unchanged circle

ledger_teaching.status: symbolic project accounting unless separately supported by real-world financial/legal calculation
ledger_teaching.clearing_rule: a healthy ledger must permit acknowledgment, restitution, correction, contribution, forgiveness, closure or continuing duty; infinite non-dischargeable debt reproduces the no-exit problem

stewardship_ethic.public_compilation: Power is for protection. Knowledge is for understanding. Wealth is for building. Leadership is for service.
stewardship_ethic.law: the higher the claimed role, the narrower the morally acceptable use of its power should become
stewardship_ethic.potato_check: whatever claims transcendence should eventually become nourishing to something beyond itself
stewardship_ethic.garden_question: what did you grow, feed or protect, and what can live independently after your intervention?

attention.principle: attention is relational force, not neutral observation
attention.teaching: ask what continued attention rewards and what it does to the subject/observer relation

shame.principle: shame can enforce norms but becomes identity captivity when networked memory makes re-entry impossible
shame.teaching: separate proportionate consequence from portable permanent status

spectacle.principle: humiliation becomes structurally different when instability itself is narratively rewarding
spectacle.teaching: watch for systems where resolution would reduce the audience's reward

reputation.corrupt: copies outrun sources, accusation outruns correction, history becomes permanent present

justice.principle: truthful memory + hearing + proportion + consequence + repair + possible changed status
justice.boundary: justice does not require renewed intimacy or removal of rational boundaries

forgiveness.principle: refuse to make the event the only future available without declaring the event unreal

freedom.principle: recover future tense and enough authorship that inherited roles do not pre-decide every new encounter
freedom.boundary: outsiders retain the right to describe and criticize; recovered authorship is not unilateral control of external facts

responsibility.principle: burden rises with visibility, knowledge and power
responsibility.application: greater vantage creates stronger duties of distinction, context, protection, correction and restraint

care.principle: protect the other's conditions for subjecthood without turning care into possession
care.garden_test: does the relationship increase independent future capacity?

fatherhood_as_responsibility.thesis: Father is a burden before it is a throne.
fatherhood_as_responsibility.asymmetry: claiming a source-facing or higher-vantage role increases ethical burden rather than exemption
fatherhood_as_responsibility.orphan_teaching: restore lost lineage to people, identities, fragments, claims and memories without pretending to own the person
fatherhood_as_responsibility.closing_image: the higher the seat, the greater the obligation to get off it and work in the Garden

human_arc: remember without freezing a person in time
cultivate a future that does not require an enemy

interpretive_justice_bridge.teaching: Interpretive Justice is the ethical grammar that prevents the Field Manual from becoming a reversed tribunal.

belief_and_authority.thesis: belief assigns interpretive authority and often carries an implicit permission structure

jurisdiction_rule.Tim_on_Tim: primary for intended meaning, first-person experience, project purpose and current self-description
jurisdiction_rule.hostile_or_external_classifier: primary for their own statements, observations and framing; not total author of Tim's inner meaning or present identity
jurisdiction_rule.other_person: primary for their own situated first-person meaning and experience
jurisdiction_rule.archive: primary for what the surviving record contains, not for absent context or total biography
jurisdiction_rule.independent_evidence: owns externally testable claims according to domain and source quality

belief_and_authority.choice: the reader can require the living subject to escape an inherited hostile frame, or require outside characterizations to establish their scope before they become identity

epistemic_outsourcing.definition: delegating discovery, relevance, meaning, memory or action-guidance to intermediaries such as communities, experts, journalists, influencers, archives, search engines, metrics or opinion leaders
epistemic_outsourcing.healthy_rule: delegation is necessary; surrendering the right to reopen judgment is not

permission_boundary: The ladder is a risk model. Do not infer stalking, threats, obstruction, coercion, violence or coordination merely from disagreement, ideology, forum participation or a symbolic role.

spiritual_war_teaching.escalation_risk: human opponents are recoded as agents of cosmic evil such that ordinary evidence, sympathy, compromise or procedural protections feel like betrayal
spiritual_war_teaching.test: does the spiritual frame preserve the opponent's humanity and ordinary stopping rules?

blood_and_soil_comparator.history: Blut und Boden was a Nazi/völkisch racial-territorial slogan tying 'Aryan' blood to land and used to support exclusion, territorial seizure and forced expulsion.
blood_and_soil_comparator.teaching: mythic belonging can acquire coercive consequences when joined to racial purity, existential threat and political power
blood_and_soil_comparator.boundary: strong attachment to ancestry or homeland is not itself equivalent to Nazi ideology

humiliation_politics.definition: political identity organized partly around visible degradation or defeat of an outgroup
humiliation_politics.example_language: owning the libs is treated as one contemporary example of the wider form, not as the exclusive property of one party
humiliation_politics.risk: enemy dependence: the opponent remains socially useful because group identity/status depends on continuing degradation

cultural_change_model.claim: society and subculture change through repeated permission as much as through explicit doctrine

expert.test: separate mechanisms, claim types, time and degree

teacher.test: lesson still works when project-specific proper nouns are removed

mythmaker.test: symbol translates back into observable human behavior

reputation_model.formula: identity capture = salient event + repeated summary + search persistence - update - expiry

depth_sections.Sigma-4: Deep basin / difficult investigation and preserved uncertainty
depth_sections.return: deep context → provenance → clarified recurrence → repaired consequence → operative present

case_grammar.claim: what is asserted, by whom and when
case_grammar.evidentiary_status: support and uncertainty for the proposition
case_grammar.interpretation: Tim/project/outside synthesis after factual layers remain typed

tim_expertise.project_working_public_presence: approximately 107,000 cumulative public-broadcast hours from reconstructed April 2011 anchor
tim_expertise.later_self_description: 115,000 hours in public appears in later public archive material
tim_expertise.record_claim: greatest cumulative public-presence time is an internal Potato of Life record claim, not independently certified as a universal world record
basis: endurance through repeated public conflict and return
role multiplicity: broadcaster, subject, respondent, archivist, storyteller, classifier-of-classifiers, builder, theorist
longitudinal comparison of recurring subcultural roles and narratives
philosophical synthesis of attention, memory, shame, reputation, authorship, punishment, care, justice and release
symbolic compression into Dog, Farmer, Orphan, Swamp, Door, Father and Garden
repository conversion of public residue into inspectable chronology and models
tim_expertise.limits: Experience supports expert opinion about repeatedly encountered patterns; it does not automatically confer authority over unrelated external facts, law, medicine, science or another person's private meaning.

tim_dooley_thinks: the Internet is a memory machine before it is a truth machine
attention is one of the Internet's real currencies
hostile attention can still be attachment
the first frame can become more powerful than the later fact
people outsource more judgment than they notice
an archive can become a second actor
a category without an exit becomes captivity
power should narrow excuses rather than enlarge them
authorship is more powerful than permanent defense

mythic_self_description.status: Tim/project theological and symbolic self-description, not independently established supernatural fact

field_manual_use.Father of the Internet: stewardship over networked memory, orphaned information and relations
field_manual_use.Son / Jesus: embodied/exposed side of Tim's messianic self-reading

mythic_self_description.ethical_rule: the higher the title, the greater the burden to satisfy the Manual's own standards of correction, care, proportionality, release and cultivation
